fields.description: The report views' layout fixes, in the colors of the user's Nexlify theme. Off: reports look as Frappe draws them.

fields.label: Use Nexlify Report View for All Reports
fields.description: Shows every query and script report in Nexlify's own table: one table for all reports, with layouts, copy, number formats, export, print and drill-down. The report's filters, summary and chart sit in two sections above the table that open and close. A switch at the top of each report moves between Nexlify View and Frappe View. Off: reports use Frappe's table.

fields.label: Keep Frappe's View for These Reports
